property_summary: After constructor, the depositorAccount is uninitialized (address(0)), so the reference's require(msg.sender == depositorAccount) reverts for any caller, but the buggy version's require(msg.sender != depositorAccount) allows any caller; thus a call from address(1) to setL1BlockValues will revert in the reference but succeed in the buggy version, and we assert that the call reverts (fails on buggy version).
